    Free groups are residually finite #

    A nontrivial reduced word L of length n moves the point n of Fin (n + 1) to 0 under suitable permutations: the j-th letter (a, ε) asks σ_a^ε (j + 1) = j, and reducedness makes these partial prescriptions injective (exists_perm_ne_one). Hence finitely many nontrivial elements of a free group survive in one finite quotient (exists_finite_quotient).
